title: Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku: restart

thread.title: Magical Girl Raising Project restart • Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku restart - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters considered this one of the strongest episodes so far, especially for its character-focused interactions.
Pfle and Mamori’s dynamic was repeatedly described as funny, while Pechka’s group was viewed favorably for functioning well as a team.
The ending and post-credits material generated strong shock and excitement, though some reactions called it especially harsh or brutal.
Commenters enjoyed the mysteries and speculation but also expressed uncertainty about character motivations and unresolved developments.
One reaction felt the episode moved very quickly and mainly looked forward to seeing whether the next episode would deliver more payoff.
